description: This file contains core thread management functions for RISC-V architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including thread creation, user mode entry, and context switching.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Initializes a new thread with stack setup, context, and entry point configuration.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions execution to user mode, setting up stack and CPU status registers.

methods.name: z_riscv_switch_to_main_no_multithreading
methods.description: Starts the main thread in a non-multithreaded environment, setting up stack and jumping to main entry.
